# Better Ibaan

A sourced civic field guide to Ibaan, Batangas. Independent of the Municipality of Ibaan.

## Sections

- [Overview](http://localhost:4321/): The town in a few official figures.
- [Municipal services](http://localhost:4321/services): What each published office provides.
- [Emergency hotlines](http://localhost:4321/hotlines): National lines and any verified local numbers.
- [Holidays](http://localhost:4321/holidays): Declared national and local dates.
- [Resort directory](http://localhost:4321/resorts): Published visitor channels, where they exist.
- [Officials and offices](http://localhost:4321/government): Seats, offices, and what can be verified.
- [Barangays](http://localhost:4321/barangays): The 26 barangays, with figures and boundaries.
- [Legislation](http://localhost:4321/legislation): Ordinances, resolutions, and orders on record.
- [History](http://localhost:4321/history): The Iba tree, the town, and the written record.
- [Statistics](http://localhost:4321/statistics): Population, households, and classification.
- [Finances](http://localhost:4321/finances): Income and spending, only where traceable.
- [Infrastructure](http://localhost:4321/infrastructure): Projects found in public project records.
- [Procurement](http://localhost:4321/procurement): Bids, awards, and notices on record.
- [Disclosures](http://localhost:4321/transparency): DILG filing index, where available.
- [Archive](http://localhost:4321/documents): Documents recovered from public pages.
- [About](http://localhost:4321/about): What this project is and how it works.
- [Sources](http://localhost:4321/sources): Where every figure comes from.
- [Open data](http://localhost:4321/data): Machine-readable datasets and provenance.
- [Accessibility](http://localhost:4321/accessibility): How this site is built to be usable.
- [Sitemap](http://localhost:4321/sitemap): Every page in the guide.
- [Geography](http://localhost:4321/geography/): boundaries, neighbours, and the barangay map
- [Heritage](http://localhost:4321/heritage/): the Iba tree and municipal heritage categories

## Machine data

- [Dataset index](http://localhost:4321/data/index.json)
- [Search index](http://localhost:4321/search.json)
- [XML sitemap](http://localhost:4321/sitemap.xml)

Use only municipal or government-hosted pages as sources. Gaps are marked as gaps; no Calatagan data is reused.
